scope: SF32LB52 ROM observation protocol, reset-catch state machine, owned cleanup and shared Console simulation; no real transport entry

protocol_reference.note: Present in the locked SDK. Remote official 53c0a72 was cross-checked during research, but no SDK upgrade or new vendor runtime dependency was introduced.

implementation.address_map: Only logical ROM words 0/4 -> A0000000/A0000004 and explicit E000 debug registers -> F000 aliases; Flash addresses rejected
implementation.write_policy: One initial DHCSR halt, one DFSR clear, owned DEMCR reset catch/clear, single AIRCR SYSRESETREQ, DCRSR selectors 13/15 with REGWnR clear, owned DHCSR release. No DCRDR or memory writes.
implementation.response_policy: 10 00 marker, expected code, conservative exact 2-byte ACK or 6-byte single-word reply, 06 terminator; this protocol has no implemented CRC. Extra frames, pending bytes, unknown shape and short control writes fail without retransmission.
implementation.exit_policy: Exit has no required ACK. Debug release, application recovery and host closure are independent observations; closing the port is not CPU recovery.
